replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I have a few questions:
1. Is that the nether wart block? If so, we can't accept it because it needs to be compatible with earlier versions.
2. Can you add more variation to the ground? (Pits, trenches) because that'd be interesting cover and unique.
3. I'd also change the red blocks to something more neutral to look better, like grass/wool/stained clay, or clay/graywool/grayclay/etc.
